preregistration.question: Do the fast policies stay within a fixed quality tolerance of BF16 on unseen inputs?
preregistration.decoding: native MTP, K=2, for every policy (matched mode)
preregistration.test: paired difference (policy minus BF16, oriented so negative is worse); non-inferior when the lower bound of the two-sided 95% paired bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples, seed 20261018) is above minus the margin
preregistration.multiplicity: Holm correction across the 6 policy x task tests, reported alongside the unadjusted intervals
preregistration.sampling: all eligible rows not used by the main study (development, evaluation, held-out, calibration), seeded stratified round robin with seed SEED+5, capped as listed; no response-dependent filtering

e4.prompt: Describe this image in detail, including all visible text.
